title: Figure 2. Inter-Universe Wormhole (top) and Intra-Universe Wormhole (bottom)
description: Two wireframe embedding (Flamm) diagrams: the top shows two flared sheets joined by a narrow throat, representing a wormhole between universes; the bottom shows an arched tube connecting two points on a single flat grid. Caption: "Figure 2. Inter-Universe Wormhole (top) and Intra-Universe Wormhole (bottom)." Text discusses wormhole throat geometry, the Null Energy Condition and the Gauss-Bonnet theorem.
